get_base_time_compute_keyframe_offset: compute a base time offset from a tensor using flow keyframes and total frames with optional jitter
get_base_time_with_jitter: compute a jittered base time tensor by adding random noise scaled by flow_scale to the time offset
get_flow_and_time_advect_flow: compute advected optical flow and base time from a flow tensor using keyframe-based time offset and activation
get_flow_and_time_rigid_flow: compute rigid optical flow by applying activation to the product of flow and time offset tensor
get_flow_and_time_with_random_offset: compute optical flow with random time offset jitter and return the flow tensor and base time
